newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police expect to find children's bodies soon.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police expect to find children's bodies soon.

text.p: Belgian police searching the city of Charleroi for traces of children who disappeared several years ago expect to find the bodies of at least two very soon, a source close to the investigations told Reuters on Friday.
"We now think that we will find the bodies of Ken (Heyrman) and Elisabeth Brichet there...possibly even today," the source said.
Ken, 8, and his brother Kim, 11, disappeared from the Belgian port city of Antwerp in January 1994. Kim was later found dead in the city.
Elisabeth Brichet, 12, disappeared in December 1989 from the town of Namur in southern Belgium.

Police have been searching at an abandoned mining complex in the Jumet suburb of Charleroi for the past four weeks, initially acting on information from the wife of convicted child rapist Marc Dutroux who led police in August to two sexually abused young girls who were rescued alive, and then the bodies of four more.
Belgian newspapers said on Friday that police were now working on information they had collected about another paedophile who has been in jail since last February.
